description: List supported capabilities separately from source health. `capabilities` reports profile/post lookup, topic video search, indexed topic search, hashtag search and country trend boards. YouTube and TikTok support topic video search; only YouTube has a country board. Only Instagram has indexed topic search, the reels on its public popular page for a word, which exists for some words only. TikTok and Instagram support hashtag search. Google Trends is a separate `/trending` source. `status` and `strategies` describe profile reads; `postStatus` and `postStrategies` describe post reads, with verification dates and the last 24 hours of results. A supported capability can still have no working source here. Free.
